info.title: For buyers and farmers
info.intro: How delivery works, how to return a product, how to reach us and how to start selling on FarmCart.
delivery: We deliver daily across Lviv and the region in two-hour slots, which you choose at checkout.
Each farm packs its own order and hands it to a courier on the delivery day; orders from several farms arrive as separate deliveries in the same slot.
Dairy, meat and eggs travel in cool bags with ice packs at +2…+6 °C.
Once delivered, put chilled products in the fridge within an hour. Ingredients, shelf life and storage for every product are on its page.
returns: You can cancel an order free of charge until the farm accepts it.
If a product is spoiled, of poor quality or missing, write to us within 24 hours of delivery and attach a photo.
We refund your card within 3 working days or replace the product in your next delivery - whichever suits you.
info.supportChannels: Call or email us - we reply within an hour during working hours.
farmers: Register your farm: its name, its location on the map and documents (organic certificate, register extract).
An administrator checks the documents; after that your products appear in the catalogue.
Orders arrive in your farmer dashboard with a notification; picking lists and packing slips can be printed.
